propositions: rebar must support s3:// URLs as sync.remote values for encrypted bucket-backed ticket stores with init, mount, create, claim, transition, push/fetch operations all succeeding against the remote
when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below v0.3.2, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the required pip install

multiple-bundle corruption (concurrent pushes leaving two <sha>.bundle files for one ref causing git ls-remote to return the ref at two SHAs and fresh clones to hard-fail) must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads while preserving all commits from every head
optional s3 dependency (git-remote-s3>=0.3.2) must be declared in pyproject.toml with availability/version guards and documented configuration including SSE-KMS bucket setup and IAM requirements
